## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Closes #N` when appropriate.

## Verification

List exact local commands and observed results. For a bug, include fail-before/pass-after evidence where feasible. Explain any relevant change in the failure oracle, source preservation, execution budget, or supported inputs.

## Review and limitations

Record local CodeRabbit dispositions and independent review for the exact HEAD. Identify remaining limitations. No remote CI is used; user authorization is required for merge.
